newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Asking price $66.00 to mostly $67.00 per cwt, with a few bids at $64.00. Last sales Thursday at $65.00.
Sales confirmed for the week to date including late Friday and the weekend on 3,100 formula and contract cattle.
Confirmed - none last week - 300 last year - none
Wk to date - 3,100 last week - 11,300 last year - 32,000
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
